site.description: An interactive showcase of reusable list page patterns built with Next.js and TypeScript.
site.socialImageAlt: Reusable List Page Architecture — one list-page system, four distinct product surfaces. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

componentsPage.title: Components
componentsPage.description: Every UI primitive in the workspace's library, searchable and filterable by category, framework and status.

issuesPage.title: Issues
issuesPage.description: Track and triage work across the workspace. Select rows to change status on several issues at once.

deploymentsPage.title: Deployments
deploymentsPage.description: Every build across environments, with status shown as icon and label — never color alone.

packagesPage.title: Packages
packagesPage.description: Dependencies tracked across the workspace, with update status surfaced before it becomes a problem.

architecturePage.title: Architecture
architecturePage.description: A URL-driven list-page system with one parsing boundary, server-rendered results, focused client controls, and page-owned domain logic.

templatesPage.title: Templates
templatesPage.description: Four composition layers, from a bare list to a fully-stateful page. Every example route in this project builds on some or all of them.

buildingBlocksPage.title: Building Blocks
buildingBlocksPage.description: Every reusable primitive in src/features/list-page/ on its own — what it renders and which examples use it.

ogImage.headline: One list-page system. Four distinct product surfaces.
